title: User access requests: Machine learning suggestions
description:
Organization admins can now use machine learning suggestions to help prioritize and manage user access requests in Atlassian Administration. By leveraging a core machine learning model, the app identifies and surfaces requests that are highly likely to be approved, allowing admins to focus on high-signal actions and reduce cognitive load when managing large volumes of requests. Go to Atlassian Administration (admin.atlassian.com).
